claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-04-06 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1004-004. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.

claims.text: Author of record per the DIA letter of 9 January 2018, item 8: "Traversable Wormholes, Stargates and Negative Energy, Dr Eric Davis, EarthTech International." The popular attribution to Davis is, in this case, correct and matches the government list.
The released cover page reads "6 April 2010 / ICOD: 1 December 2009 / DIA-08-1004-004." The author line is redacted under (b)(6).

EarthTech International's own citation list records the paper as "Davis, E. W. (2010), 'Traversable Wormholes, Stargates, and Negative Energy,' Defense Intelligence Reference Document, Acquisition Threat Support, DIA-08-1004-004, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency, Washington, DC."

This is one of the first two DIRDs to reach the public internet, appearing on a website operated by Corey Goode in an item dated 18 December 2017, before any FOIA release. Davis confirmed by email to the researcher Isaac Koi that the circulating copies were his documents.

connections.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
connections.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.
